summary: Stop storing per-site excerpt/line_hint diagnostics in the SQLite large-value inventory; the guard recomputes them from source when reporting findings

replay.detail: Development inventory tooling only; replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database changes; the inventory drops two diagnostic-only JSON fields per site record.

rules.detail: Source exception acceptance and runtime rules are unchanged; the same sites pass or fail.

compatibility.detail: Site records keep id, path, kind, fingerprint, owner, todo and disposition; records carrying extra fields are rejected so the stored format stays canonical.

manual.detail: Failure messages now report the excerpt and location computed from current source, e.g. 'unregistered <kind> <id> at <path>:<line>: <excerpt>'. No workflow change beyond regenerating the inventory via the existing guard.

recovery.detail: No persistent runtime state changes; no recovery action required.
